question: Convert (2π)/(3) radians to degrees.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The fastest way to convert radians to degrees is to substitute π with 180°.

⇒ Angle = 2 × 180° / 3

⇒ Angle = 360° / 3 = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**
